UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Cloud-synced campaign progress, cosmetics, and daily challenge personal best for an authenticated player.

displayName.description: Public display callsign of the player (no PII email/phone).

completedLevels.description: Bounded list of completed campaign level numbers (up to 100).

unlockedCosmetics.description: Bounded list of unlocked cosmetic IDs (up to 20).

dailyBestDate.description: UTC date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of the player's latest daily challenge completion.

dailyBestTimeMs.description: Player's best completion time in milliseconds for dailyBestDate.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last synced.

DailyLeaderboardEntry.title: DailyLeaderboardEntry
DailyLeaderboardEntry.description: A player's fastest completion time for a specific UTC date's Daily Challenge seeded maze.

uid.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID who achieved this run.

displayName.description: Player callsign shown on the global leaderboard.

dateKey.description: UTC date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

seed.description: Deterministic 32-bit maze seed for that date.

coinsCollected.description: Coins collected during the winning run (0 to 500).

damageTaken.description: Hits taken during the winning run (0 to 100).

skinId.description: Equipped skin ID used on the run.

isPublic.description: Explicit boolean flag (always true) enforced by list security rules.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores private cloud-synced campaign progress and cosmetics per authenticated user.

/dailyLeaderboards/{entryId}.description: Stores global Daily Challenge completion times indexed by entryId ({dateKey}_{uid}).
